cards.title: 日常工作 · 一次侧干管结露：是冷凝水，不是漏
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：早班接班前的冷机房与液冷区巡检。CDU 二次侧运行平稳，但你走到一次侧冷冻水供液干管时发现 C 柱附近的保温层裂开约半米，正下方地面积了一摊水。你要先判断这是漏液还是结露，再决定是记一笔卫生整改还是开工单当天处理。

**对话：**
- Dave: Morning. The liquid loop is steady overnight - two CDUs in lead, one on standby, secondary supply thirty-four point eight.
- 小白: On the primary side, I found a wet patch under the supply header near column C. The insulation is split open for about half a metre, right where the header crosses over the hot aisle return.
- Dave: Is it leaking? I walked that aisle twice and the floor was dry at four in the morning.
- 小白: It is condensation, not a leak. The vapour barrier is torn, so seven-degree water is sweating straight through the insulation. Feel it - the water is cold and clean, and the make-up meter has not moved since yesterday. A real leak would show on the make-up first, and the drip pan alarm would have caught it long before it reached the floor.
- Dave: So we log it as a housekeeping item?
- 小白: No. It goes on a corrective work order today, not next week. Wet insulation stops insulating, and once it is soaked through it starts rotting the pipe underneath. I will tape it as a temporary stop, re-insulate with a proper vapour-sealed section, and leave a drip tray under it until the work order is signed off.
- Dave: Anything else before I go home?
- 小白: One thing. Check the condensate trays in the CRAH units on the same row. If the room dew point has crept up, this will not be the only wet spot we find this week. Log the reading and I will compare it against last week's before I decide whether it is one bad section or a humidity problem.

**重点表达：**
- `It is condensation, not a leak.` — 这是结露，不是漏液
- `The vapour barrier is torn.` — 防潮层/隔汽层破了
- `Seven-degree water is sweating through the insulation.` — 7℃冷冻水正透过保温层出汗结露
- `The make-up meter has not moved since yesterday.` — 补液表从昨天起就没动过
- `A real leak would show on the make-up first.` — 真漏的话补水量会先有反应
- `Log it as a housekeeping item.` — 记成一条卫生整改项
- `It goes on a corrective work order today.` — 今天就要开 corrective 工单
- `Wet insulation stops insulating.` — 保温层吸水后就不再保温
- `Tape it as a temporary stop.` — 先用胶带做临时封堵
- `Re-insulate with a vapour-sealed section.` — 换成带完整隔汽层的保温管壳重做
- `Check the condensate trays in the CRAH units.` — 去查一下 CRAH 的冷凝水盘
- `The room dew point has crept up.` — 机房露点慢慢爬上来了
- `Compare it against last week's reading.` — 拿它跟上周的读数对比

cards.title: 故障排查 · 板换内漏：水在往里进，不是往外漏
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：月度水质台账复盘。二次侧膨胀罐补液频次本月涨到三倍，乙二醇浓度从 25% 掉到 21%，电导率同步上升。所有支路流量正常、接水盘干燥，你怀疑是一次侧冷冻水通过 CDU 板换的微孔渗进了二次侧，需要在不停机的前提下确认，并给出临时控制与验证方案。

**对话：**
- Nina: Your make-up rate on the secondary loop is up threefold this month, and glycol has dropped from twenty-five to twenty-one percent. Something is either leaking out or diluting in.
- 小白: Diluting in. We have no visible loss, the drip trays are dry, and every branch flow meter reads where it did last month. If we were losing coolant we would see it in the pit or on a tray long before the tank noticed.
- Nina: Then it is the plate heat exchanger. Primary into secondary through a pinhole.
- 小白: That is my read. Secondary conductivity is climbing and the pH is drifting toward the primary side - the water is coming in, not going out. The question is how we prove it without pulling the plant down.
- Nina: Pressure test. Isolate the primary, drain it, and watch the secondary side.
- 小白: Standard way, yes, but that takes a CDU out of service and puts the row on one train. Cheaper first step: close the primary isolation valves, leave the secondary pumps running, and watch the expansion tank level and the conductivity for an hour. If the level keeps rising with the primary side isolated and depressurised, the leak is in the pack, not in a fitting.
- Nina: And if the level holds?
- 小白: Then it is not the plates - it is make-up water on our own side, and I have been chasing the wrong thing for a week. But if it rises, we open the pack. Until then, compensating control: set the make-up to manual, hold concentration at twenty-two percent minimum so we keep freeze protection, and log conductivity twice a shift. Failover to the standby CDU tested clean yesterday, latency was under a second and inlet never moved - so redundancy is fine. Headroom is what I am protecting now, not uptime.
- Nina: How long before you open it?
- 小白: Two days for the gasket set and the plate pack spare, and I want the manufacturer commissioning engineer here for the re-torque. Torquing a plate pack is not a spanner job - the sequence and the final dimension are both specified, and if we get it wrong we crack a plate and the leak gets worse instead of better.

**重点表达：**
- `Something is either leaking out or diluting in.` — 要么是在往外漏，要么是被稀释
- `The water is coming in, not going out.` — 水是往里进，不是往外漏
- `Primary into secondary through a pinhole.` — 一次侧经微孔渗进二次侧
- `How do we prove it without pulling the plant down.` — 不停机怎么验证
- `It puts the row on one train.` — 这会让整排只剩一套在跑
- `Close the primary isolation valves.` — 关掉一次侧隔离阀
- `The level keeps rising with the primary side isolated.` — 一次侧隔离后液位还在涨
- `The leak is in the pack, not in a fitting.` — 漏点在板片组，不在管件
- `Set the make-up to manual.` — 把补水切到手动
- `Compensating control.` — 临时补偿性控制措施
- `Hold concentration at twenty-two percent minimum.` — 浓度最低保持在 22%
- `We keep freeze protection.` — 保住防冻能力
- `Headroom is what I am protecting, not uptime.` — 我现在护的是余量，不是可用性
- `Failover to the standby CDU tested clean.` — 切备用 CDU 测试正常
- `Torquing a plate pack is not a spanner job.` — 板换压紧不是拿扳手拧紧就行
- `The sequence and the final dimension are both specified.` — 拧紧顺序和最终压紧尺寸都是有规定的

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 冷板到货验收：先开箱，再签字
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：新一批 60 块冷板到货。供应商希望你先在送货单上签字，你坚持先开箱核对。核对中发现外包装标注的螺纹规格与订单不符，另有两块冷板磕碰变形，你要开 NCR 并要求换货而不是打折，同时把随货证书清单一次讲清。

**对话：**
- Leo: Sixty cold plates, all crated. Do you want to sign the delivery note now, or after you open them?
- 小白: After. I am not signing for sixty plates I have not looked at. Let me match the packing list against the purchase order first - model, port size, and thread.
- Leo: Everything is per the order. I checked before dispatch.
- 小白: The thread is the part that catches people out. The order says G half, not NPT half. They look nearly identical on the bench and they will not seal against each other. Two of these crates are labelled NPT on the outside, and I am not finding that out on the rack at eleven at night.
- Leo: Let me check with the factory.
- 小白: While you do: two plates in crate four have dented corners and one has a bent mounting ear. Deformed is not cosmetic here - the mounting ear carries the torque that holds the plate against the chip. I am putting both on an NCR with photos, and I want replacements, not credit on the next invoice.
- Leo: We could offer a discount on those two.
- 小白: I do not want a discount on a part I cannot mount. And I still need your paperwork before anything goes on a rack: the hydrostatic test certificate per plate, the cleanliness report with particle count and residual moisture, and the certificate of conformance with heat numbers traceable to the batch. Without those I cannot close the work order, and the warranty clock has not started.
- Leo: Understood. I will get the NCR raised today.
- 小白: One more thing - lead time on the two replacements, in writing, and crated separately so they do not disappear into the next shipment. We have an install window in three weeks and I am not holding a rack open because two plates went back.

**重点表达：**
- `I am not signing for sixty plates I have not looked at.` — 没开箱验过的货我不签
- `Match the packing list against the purchase order.` — 把装箱单和采购订单逐项核对
- `The thread is the part that catches people out.` — 最容易踩坑的就是螺纹规格
- `G half, not NPT half.` — 要 G 半寸，不是 NPT 半寸
- `They will not seal against each other.` — 这两种螺纹互相密封不上
- `Deformed is not cosmetic here.` — 变形在这里不是外观问题
- `The mounting ear carries the torque.` — 安装耳承受压紧扭矩
- `Put it on an NCR with photos.` — 开不合格报告并附照片
- `Replacements, not credit on the next invoice.` — 要换货，不是下张发票抵账
- `Hydrostatic test certificate per plate.` — 每块板的水压试验报告
- `Cleanliness report with particle count and residual moisture.` — 含颗粒度和残留水分的清洁度报告
- `Certificate of conformance, traceable to the batch.` — 可追溯到批次的合格证明
- `The warranty clock has not started.` — 质保期还没开始起算
- `Lead time in writing, crated separately.` — 货期要书面确认，并且单独装箱
- `I am not holding a rack open because two plates went back.` — 我不会为了退回两块板而一直空着一个机位

cards.title: 运维沟通 · CDU 二次侧定流量改变频：省下的泵功不能拿最小流速去换
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：液冷区投运大半年，二次侧泵从第一天起就定频运行。你翻了三个月的运行数据：负荷长期在 30%–45%，但泵始终满速，泵功在部分负荷时占液冷总能耗接近一成。你想申请给泵加变频，改成按最不利支路压差控制，并把最小频率、低流量告警和回退方案一并谈清楚。

**对话：**
- Karen: You asked for fifteen minutes on the secondary loop. What is on your mind?
- 小白: The pumps. They have run at constant speed since day one, and at thirty to forty-five percent load we are paying full pumping power to move half the water we actually need.
- Karen: And you want drives on them.
- 小白: Variable speed, controlled on differential pressure at the worst branch — not on flow, and not on a timer. The index circuit is the far end of row D, and I want the sensor there, not on the pump discharge.
- Karen: Why not at the discharge?
- 小白: Because a discharge sensor controls the pump, not the load. It holds pressure where pressure is easy to hold and lets the far end starve the moment valves open up. That is the same mistake we made on the primary side two years ago, and it cost us a low delta-T we spent a quarter chasing.
- Karen: What stops you from starving it here?
- 小白: A floor on the drive: thirty-five hertz minimum, which keeps every cold plate above its minimum velocity, plus a low-flow alarm on each branch. If the far end cannot hold its differential, the drive ramps back to full speed and stays there. It fails safe, and more importantly it tells us the loop is out of range instead of quietly running a plate dry.
- Karen: Give me the energy case.
- 小白: Pumping is about nine percent of the liquid-cooling load at part load today, and the fans and chillers do not move at all. I model roughly four points off that — but measured, not modelled, is the part I care about. Two weeks of baseline with the drives in hand, then two weeks automated, same load bands, and we compare kilowatt-hours against heat actually moved.
- Karen: Risk to the IT load?
- 小白: One CDU at a time, never both trains. Window has the manufacturer commissioning engineer on site plus our own witness, and rollback is fifty seconds — put the drive in bypass and we are exactly where we started. I am not asking for a new loop, Karen. I am asking to stop paying for head we do not need.

**重点表达：**
- `We are paying full pumping power to move half the water.` — 我们花着满额泵功，只送了一半的水量
- `Controlled on differential pressure at the worst branch.` — 按最不利支路压差控制
- `The index circuit is the far end of row D.` — 最不利回路在 D 排末端
- `A discharge sensor controls the pump, not the load.` — 装在泵出口的传感器控的是泵，不是负荷
- `It lets the far end starve the moment valves open up.` — 阀门一开，末端就会缺流量
- `A floor on the drive: thirty-five hertz minimum.` — 给变频器设下限：最低 35Hz
- `It keeps every cold plate above its minimum velocity.` — 保证每块冷板都高于最小流速
- `It fails safe.` — 它失效时导向安全侧
- `Measured, not modelled, is the part I care about.` — 我在意的是实测值，不是模型值
- `Two weeks of baseline, then two weeks automated.` — 先两周基线，再两周投自动
- `Kilowatt-hours against heat actually moved.` — 每移走单位热量所耗的千瓦时
- `I am asking to stop paying for head we do not need.` — 我只是想不再为我们用不上的扬程付钱

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 全站失电演练评审：液冷区没有风冷区那份蓄冷缓冲
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
**情境**：年度全站失电（black start）演练前的联合评审会。你坚持 CDU 泵必须排进柴发带载序列的第一批，并且要求泵和控制一起接 UPS。电气和 IT 两边都有意见：电气嫌电池容量不够，IT 嫌分批上电中的 hold point 影响业务。你要把液冷与风冷在热惯性上的本质差别讲透，并把三个可量化的 abort criterion 写进 runbook。

**对话：**
- Miguel: Your CDU pumps want to be first in the generator start sequence. That puts them ahead of two IT pods.
- 小白: They have to be. When the mains drop, the air-cooled halls coast for minutes — the slab, the rack frames, the CRAH casings, all of that is thermal mass. The liquid loop has none of it. It has the coolant in the pipe and maybe thirty seconds before GPU inlet starts climbing.
- Miguel: Thirty seconds is not in our sequence. ATS transfer, generator start, first block on the bus — best case is ninety.
- 小白: Then we own the gap: thirty seconds of loop, ninety seconds of generator, and the difference has to come from somewhere. It comes from UPS on the pumps. We ride through on battery instead of restarting cold. That is the ask — pumps and controls on UPS, not the pumps alone.
- Miguel: Controls too? That is a lot more battery.
- 小白: Because pumps without controls are just circulation. If the controller reboots, it comes back with the valve at its failsafe position, and I get no flow to the plates for the ninety seconds it takes to re-establish. I want the valve to hold last position through the transfer. Pumps spinning against a closed valve buys me nothing.
- Miguel: And once the generators are on?
- 小白: Staged restart, and that is where we clash with IT. I cannot bring four hundred kilowatts of cold plates back to full flow in one step — the chillers have to re-establish the primary loop first, and if I open everything at once I pull secondary supply down and trip on low temperature. So: pumps first, primary loop stable, then IT load in blocks with a hold point between each one.
- Miguel: IT will call the hold points lost revenue.
- 小白: And I will call an unplanned load shed more expensive than the ninety seconds they planned for. Blast radius, Miguel — if we open the loop too fast, it is not one pod that drops, it is every rack on that CDU. Their pod-level restart assumes the cooling underneath is already stable. It is not. That assumption is the single point of failure in this plan, and right now it is wearing an electrical label.
- Miguel: What goes in the runbook, then?
- 小白: Three abort criteria, written with numbers: secondary supply above thirty-eight for more than ten seconds, branch flow below eighty percent for more than thirty seconds, or generator frequency outside band. Any one of them and we stop the sequence, hold, and re-assess — nobody pushes on. And we walk it in stages before the real drill: pumps only, then pumps plus one pod, then the full sequence. This plant has never been through a black start with the liquid loop loaded, and I am not going to discover the timing during the drill itself.

**重点表达：**
- `The liquid loop has none of that thermal mass.` — 液冷回路没有那份热惯性
- `It has maybe thirty seconds before inlet starts climbing.` — 大约三十秒后进液温度就要往上走
- `We ride through on battery instead of restarting cold.` — 我们用电池扛过去，而不是冷态重启
- `Pumps without controls are just circulation.` — 没有控制的泵只是让水转起来而已
- `The valve comes back at its failsafe position.` — 阀门复位到故障安全位
- `I want the valve to hold last position through the transfer.` — 我要阀门在切换过程中保持最後位置

cards.title: 容量规划 · 二期 1.5MW 扩容：瓶颈先出现在一次侧干管，不在 CDU
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：二期液冷扩容评审。规划侧的建议很直接：机位够放六台 CDU，那就一次买齐。你算完一轮后认为真正的瓶颈不在二次侧，而在一次侧冷冻水干管与冷机出力；你提出先提一次侧供水温度、二次侧放宽到 35℃，CDU 分 4+2 两期上，避免两年闲置容量。

**对话：**
- Priya: We have room for another six CDUs in the gallery. Is that enough for one point five megawatts?
- 小白: Not with the primary side as it stands. The CDUs are not the constraint — the chilled water header is. At one point two megawatts the DN250 main is already at its practical velocity, and the plant pumps are near the end of their curve.
- Priya: Then we upsize the header.
- 小白: That is a shutdown and a hot tap, and it puts the whole liquid zone on one train for a day. Let me offer a cheaper order of work: raise primary supply from seven to twelve degrees first. Every degree up buys chiller capacity and free-cooling hours, and it takes load off the compressor without touching a single pipe.
- Priya: Twelve degrees on the primary. What does that do to the CDUs?
- 小白: Their approach is one and a half Kelvin, so I lose roughly five degrees of secondary range before I have to move anything. Secondary can sit at thirty-five comfortably — the cold plates are rated for forty-five on the coolant side. That is the part people get wrong: we are not short of cold water, we are short of temperature difference.
- Priya: Walk me through six CDUs, then.
- 小白: Six gives one point eight megawatts of nameplate on a three-plus-one arrangement, but nameplate is not capacity. Run them at eighty percent each and you get one point four four with a train in reserve. Right-size in stages — four now, two when the load actually shows up. Buy all six on day one and we pay for two years of stranded capacity, and the last two units run past their warranty clock before they ever carry load.
- Priya: And if the load arrives faster than we stage it?
- 小白: Then the bottleneck moves back to the header, and we do the hot tap with two years of trend data behind us — and with the second gallery already piped, so it is a day of work, not a week. Phasing is not caution, Priya. It is buying information with money we have not spent yet.

cards.title: 日常工作 · 红外巡检发现冷板进出液接反：流量正常，温度符号却是反的
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：液冷区月度红外巡检，你照例拿着红外枪沿 C 排走一遍。走到 C7 机柜时读数不对劲：本该更凉的供液支管，测出来比回液支管还热了两度多。DCIM 上这台机柜一切正常——支路流量在设定值、CDU 无告警。你要向值班主管说明这是冷板进出液在 manifold 处接反了，并推动同批次机柜全量排查。

**对话：**
- Dan: Anything worth writing up from the walk-down?
- 小白: One, and the dashboard would never have caught it. On rack C7 the supply branch is reading warmer than the return by about two degrees.
- Dan: Swap the probes?
- 小白: No, I checked with the gun twice and against the neighbouring rack. The sign is flipped. Cold plates are directional — flow enters at the inlet port and picks up heat on the way out. Piped backwards, the plate still passes its full flow, so branch flow sits right on setpoint and the CDU sees nothing wrong. It just stops moving heat the way the datasheet promised.
- Dan: So the cabinet is being cooled, just badly.
- 小白: Degraded quietly instead of tripping, which is worse for us. The GPU inlet is running eight degrees hotter than its neighbours at the same load, and it will throttle on the next training run. Nothing in our alarming would have told you, because we alarm on flow and on supply temperature, not on the sign of the delta across a single cold plate.
- Dan: Fix it now or at the next window?
- 小白: Now, but properly. Lock out and isolate the branch, break the two couplings, swap them, then re-verify with the gun before I walk away — same load point, five minutes apart, and I want to see the sign flip back. If I just swap and leave, I have traded one assumption for another.
- Dan: And the rest of the row?
- 小白: Every cabinet in that batch, all twenty-four. Whatever let this one go backwards at the manifold is mechanical, not bad luck: either the couplings are not keyed and someone crossed them, or the whole batch was piped from the same drawing error. I am not closing this work order until I have twenty-four readings in the log.
- Dan: Get photos.
- 小白: Already on it — before, during and after, tagged against the work order number. The lesson for the team is simple: walk the row with the gun, not with the dashboard. A control screen will happily show you a healthy loop that is running backwards.

**重点表达：**
- `The supply branch is reading warmer than the return.` — 供液支管测出来比回液支管还热
- `The sign is flipped.` — 符号反了——指温差正负号
- `Cold plates are directional.` — 冷板是有方向性的
- `Branch flow sits right on setpoint.` — 支路流量稳稳落在设定值上
- `The CDU sees nothing wrong.` — CDU 看不出任何异常
- `It degrades quietly instead of tripping.` — 它是悄悄劣化，而不是直接跳机告警
- `We alarm on flow, not on the sign of the delta.` — 我们告的是流量，不是温差的正负号
- `Lock out and isolate the branch.` — 上锁并隔离该支路
- `Re-verify with the gun before I walk away.` — 走人之前再用红外枪复核一遍
- `Same load point, five minutes apart.` — 同一负荷点，间隔五分钟再测一次
- `Tagged against the work order number.` — 按工单号做好标记记录

cards.title: 故障排查 · 趋势图风平浪静，GPU 却周期性降频：采样率把振荡抹平了
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
**情境**：C 排 GPU 节点连续三晚出现 inlet 高温降频，但 DCIM 上二次侧供液温度一周都是一条 30℃ 的直线。你怀疑真正的振荡被趋势的平均算法抹掉了，于是拉了一秒级原始数据和监控负责人一起做 RCA：CDU 三通阀 hunting、温度探头位置离板换太近，而前阵子那次漂亮的冗余切换反而把根因藏了起来。

**对话：**
- Sarah: Nodes in row C have throttled three nights running, but the coolant trend has been flat at thirty all week. What am I missing?
- 小白: Nothing in the data — a problem in how we store it. That trend is a five-minute mean. The oscillation has a period of about forty seconds, so a five-minute average turns a two-and-a-half Kelvin sawtooth into a perfectly straight line.
- Sarah: Two and a half Kelvin swing? That would show up somewhere.
- 小白: It shows up in the raw one-second points I pulled off the controller, and it shows up as throttling on the nodes — which is exactly what we have been treating as an IT problem. You are not missing data, Sarah. You are looking at a smoothed version of it.
- Sarah: What is driving it?
- 小白: CDU two's three-way valve is hunting. The temperature probe sits too close to the plate exchanger, so it reads the mixed stream before the loop actually responds. The controller sees a lag, opens the valve, overshoots, corrects, and the amplitude grows as load drops — classic loop oscillation, not a capacity problem.
- Sarah: Why now, though? Nothing changed on the plant side.
- 小白: Two things moved at once. We lowered secondary supply from thirty-two to thirty, which pushed the valve into a narrower, far more sensitive band of its stroke. And last week's pump failover landed right in the middle of the first swing, so everyone wrote the incident off as a changeover transient.
- Sarah: The failover was clean.
- 小白: Textbook — four seconds latency, no node dropped, nothing to report. And that is exactly how it cost us two weeks. The redundancy did its job and hid the root cause. A clean failover tells you the backup works; it does not tell you why the primary was unhappy. We closed the incident on the wrong question.
- Sarah: So what do we change?
- 小白: Three fixes. Move the probe downstream so the controller sees what the racks see. Retune the loop with a wider deadband and a slower integral action. And change the trend server to store one-second data for that point with min and max, not just average — if we only keep means, we will keep missing every oscillation we have not thought to look for. Then we re-run a load step from thirty to seventy percent and watch it on the one-second trace.

**重点表达：**
- `The trend is a five-minute mean.` — 这条趋势是五分钟均值
- `A five-minute average turns the sawtooth into a straight line.` — 五分钟平均把锯齿波抹成了一条直线
- `You are not missing data; you are looking at a smoothed version of it.` — 你不是缺数据，你看的是被平滑过的版本
- `The three-way valve is hunting.` — 三通阀在反复调节振荡
- `It reads the mixed stream before the loop responds.` — 它在回路真正响应前读到的是混合后的流体
- `It opens, overshoots, corrects.` — 开大、超调、再回调
- `The amplitude grows as load drops.` — 负荷越低，振幅越大
- `A narrower, far more sensitive band of its stroke.` — 行程中更窄也更敏感的一段
- `Everyone wrote the incident off as a changeover transient.` — 大家都把它当作切换扰动一笔带过
- `The redundancy did its job and hid the root cause.` — 冗余起作用了，却把根因藏了起来
- `Failover latency was four seconds, textbook.` — 切换时延四秒，教科书级别
- `Store one-second data with min and max, not just average.` — 存一秒级数据并保留最小最大值，不能只存均值

cards.title: 供应商对接 · CDU 现场验收测试谈判：把 30% 部分负荷和掉电工况写进测试矩阵
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：二期两台 CDU 到货，供应商的标准 SAT 方案只有一条：满载连续运行 4 小时，签字后质保起算。你要把 30% 部分负荷、泵 failover 计时、带载掉电恢复和漏液检测联动写进测试矩阵，并把尾项整改时限、10% 尾款释放节点和质保范围谈清楚。

**对话：**
- Weber: Our standard SAT is four hours at full load. We sign the sheet and the warranty clock starts.
- 小白: We do not run at full load on day one. This zone fills over three quarters, so what I need proven is thirty percent, not one hundred.
- Weber: Thirty percent is where every unit looks good.
- 小白: Thirty percent is where every unit gets sloppy. That is where the three-way valve sits at the sensitive end of its stroke and the pumps ride the left side of their curve. Hold secondary supply within plus or minus half a Kelvin at thirty percent for two hours, and I will believe the rest of the range without testing every point on it.
- Weber: And the power-failure test? That is not in scope.
- 小白: It is now. I want a loaded dropout: pumps and controls on UPS, three minutes down, then restore — and I want to see the loop come back without a manual reset and without a single node seeing an inlet spike. I also want a pump failover with a stopwatch on it. Your spec says ten seconds; I want the number on the sheet, not the number in the brochure.
- Weber: All of that moves the schedule by a week.
- 小白: Then we move it. Here is the trade: you keep your four-hour full-load run, and we add partial load, failover and dropout tests around it. In exchange, punch list items get a ten-working-day close-out, and anything that touches cooling capacity gets fixed before we sign, not after. Final ten percent of payment releases on SAT sign-off, not on delivery.
- Weber: Warranty starts at sign-off, then?
- 小白: Warranty starts at SAT sign-off — and it covers the leak-detection interlock and the control logic, not just the steel and the plate pack. If we find a control bug in month thirteen, I do not want to be arguing about whether software is hardware.
- Weber: Our legal team will push back on control logic.
- 小白: Mine will push back on a unit that passed a four-hour test and then could not hold temperature at part load. We are not asking for more than the machine claims to do. We are asking you to demonstrate it on our load profile, on our clock, with a witness from our side and a copy of the raw data — not a summary report written after the fact.

**重点表达：**
- `Our standard SAT is four hours at full load.` — 我们的标准 SAT 是满载四小时
- `The warranty clock starts at sign-off.` — 质保期从验收签字起算
- `Thirty percent is where every unit gets sloppy.` — 30% 负荷才是各台机组露馅的地方
- `The sensitive end of its stroke.` — 行程中最敏感的一端
- `The pumps ride the left side of their curve.` — 水泵工作在曲线的左端
- `Within plus or minus half a Kelvin.` — 控制在正负 0.5K 以内
- `A loaded dropout test.` — 带载掉电测试
- `Come back without a manual reset.` — 无需人工复位即可自行恢复
- `I want the number on the sheet, not the number in the brochure.` — 我要的是记录表上的数字，不是样本册上的数字
- `Punch list items get a ten-working-day close-out.` — 尾项清单十个工作日内关闭
- `Anything that touches cooling capacity gets fixed before we sign.` — 凡涉及制冷能力的，签字前必须整改完
- `Final ten percent releases on SAT sign-off, not on delivery.` — 最后 10% 尾款在 SAT 签字后释放，不是到货即付

cards.title: 运维沟通 · CDU 板换趋近温度五个月爬高超 1.5K：是结垢，还是缺流量
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：近五个月，2 号 CDU 板式换热器的趋近温度（approach）从 1.8K 一路爬到 3.4K。同样的 IT 负荷、同样的一次侧供水温度，你却要把一次侧电动阀开得越来越大才能维持二次侧供液设定值。你在周会上把这个趋势摆出来，说服主管安排一次化学清洗窗口，而不是等供液温度失控再抢修。

**对话：**
- Mark: You flagged unit two on the weekly call. Walk me through what we are actually looking at.
- 小白: Unit two's approach has crept from one point eight to three point four Kelvin in five months. Same load, same chilled water supply, but I am opening the primary valve further every month just to hold secondary supply.
- Mark: Fouling?
- 小白: That is the working theory, and the shape of the curve is what sells it. A sticking valve or a dying sensor steps: one morning the number jumps and stays there. This has drifted every single week in the same direction. That is a plate pack slowly losing heat transfer, either scale or biofilm on the secondary side.
- Mark: Can you confirm it without opening the unit?

The last piece needs chemistry: full fluid panel, not just glycol percentage. Everything stays in service for that. I am not spending uptime to satisfy curiosity.
- Mark: How long can it run like this?
- 小白: Six to eight weeks of margin, maybe less once we hit summer load. - Mark: Book it. And bring me before-and-after numbers.

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 液冷服务器在线拔出的正确顺序：把口头约定变成书面流程
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
**情境**：IT 团队要在不停机前提下把 C4 机柜里的 12 号 GPU 节点拉出来换主板，这意味着要断开该冷板支路的 drip-less 快接头。现在现场只有一句「到时候给小白打个电话」。你要把这件事升级成书面作业流程：谁隔离、谁排空、谁验证复压排气、谁签字把节点交还 IT，以及 CDU 的流量联锁怎么确认。

**对话：**
- Priya: We need node twelve out of rack C4 on Tuesday. I have the outage slot from the service desk, but they told me to square it with facilities first.
- 小白: Then we need a written sequence, not a phone call. That node hangs off branch five, and branch five shares a manifold with three neighbouring racks. The moment we break those couplings, loop pressure dips and every other cold plate on that manifold sees the transient.
- Priya: It is a five-minute swap.
- 小白: Draining is not the risk; improvising is. If we close the isolation valve and pull the coupler dry, we trap fluid in the node and make a mess on the rack floor. If we drain properly, we then owe everyone a proper repressurisation and vent before anything gets power back. And there is an interlock angle: the CDU will happily keep pumping against a closed branch, so losing shared cooling on the row would fail over to the redundant pump while nothing is actually wrong. A failover that nobody called is its own incident.
- Priya: Walk me through it then.
- 小白: Close the two isolations, drain branch five into a tray, pull the node, swap the board, reseat it, then refill and vent through the service ports until the sight glass is clean. A hold point there — both of us looking at it, not you texting me. Only when I see stable differential pressure and dry fittings do I hand the node back to you. If any step fails, you get a one-line note and the node stays out.
- Priya: And the uplink switches in that rack? They are air-cooled, sitting in the same hot aisle.
- 小白: Good catch, that is why the CRAHs in that row stay online during the whole job. Whatever heat the node was putting into the coolant stops going there, but the switches still dump into the hot aisle, so we are not touching the air side. Ten degrees of inlet there and we abort.
- Priya: What about nights and weekends, when you are not on site?
- 小白: That is the part I do not like about the current arrangement. Whoever is standing there ends up wearing my hat. I would rather train two of your techs, laminate the sequence, and hang it inside the CDU door than let anyone improvise around quick-disconnects at two in the morning. Ten minutes done right beats a dead node and a coolant spill by a mile.
- Priya: Do it. Send me the draft and I will countersign it.
- 小白: Draft by tomorrow, and I will add one line at the top: nobody opens a liquid-cooled node until both signatures are on the sheet. Uptime is a shared number, so the permission should be too.

- `Square it with facilities first.` — 先跟设施团队对齐——跨团队协作的开场常用句
- `We need a written sequence, not a phone call.` — 我们要的是书面顺序，不是通个电话
- `Every other cold plate on that manifold sees the transient.` — 同一母管上的其他冷板都会感受到这个扰动
- `Draining is not the risk; improvising is.` — 风险不在排液，在现场临场发挥
- `We trap fluid in the node.` — 我们会把液体封在节点里
- `Refill and vent through the service ports.` — 经检修口补液并排气
- `A failover that nobody called is its own incident.` — 没人发起的自动切换本身就是一次事件
- `A hold point — both of us looking at it.` — 设一个停止点：我们俩一起现场确认
- `Ten degrees of inlet there and we abort.` — 那里进风超过十度我们就中止
- `Whoever is standing there ends up wearing my hat.` — 谁在现场谁就得顶我的角色
- `Ten minutes done right beats a dead node and a coolant spill by a mile.` — 十分钟做对，远胜于报废一台节点加一地冷却液

cards.title: 容量规划 · 铭牌余量 500kW 为什么装不下 12 台 40kW 机柜：GPU 负载的 diversity 陷阱
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：容量同事想把一批 12 台 40kW 的 GPU 液冷机柜放进一期液冷区，理由是 CDU 铭牌还有大约 500kW 余量。你要说明：原设计按通用计算负载取了 0.8 的 diversity factor，而 GPU 训练集群几乎同步起停、长时间满载，铭牌余量并不能直接换算成可投放容量；同时给出分期投放方案与 plant 侧的真实瓶颈位置。

**对话：**
- Tom: Nameplate says each CDU pair gives us two hundred kilowatts. We have four pairs and we are loading maybe three hundred. So I have five hundred of headroom, right?
- 小白: On paper, yes. That number assumes the load behaves like general compute.
- Tom: Meaning?
- 小白: Diversity. Ordinary racks peak at different times, so the whole design runs on a factor of about zero point eight of connected load and nobody notices. A GPU training cluster does not do that. Every node starts together, runs flat out for hours, then stops together. Coincident load becomes connected load, and your five hundred quietly becomes about three hundred.
- Tom: Three hundred still covers twelve racks at forty.
- 小白: If they were the only thing drawing off those plates. They are not. The top-of-rack switches and any two-U boxes that did not get a cold plate still dump their heat straight into the hot aisle, so the row is not one hundred percent liquid even when every rack says it is. Count another fifteen percent before any of this reaches the coolant.
- Tom: Fine. So what fits?
- 小白: Eight now, four when the second CDU pair lands next quarter. And I would rather wire and stub the manifolds for twelve now, with spare connections capped, than bring twelve frames in and light eight. A rack you install but cannot energise is stranded capacity: you paid for the frame, the hot-cold aisle space and the PDU, and it sits there behind blanking panels earning nothing.
- Tom: Is the chiller plant the next constraint?
- 小白: Actually no, and that is the one piece of good news. Liquid runs warm: thirty-degree secondary return versus twelve-degree chilled water means higher suction pressure, better chiller efficiency, and far more waterside economiser hours. So plant-level refrigeration capacity is comfortable.
- Tom: PUE?
- 小白: Should come down, because we take most of the fan power out of the CRAHs in that zone. My point is not that we lack capacity, Tom. It is that the constraint moved: it used to sit at the chiller plant, and now it sits inside the white space, in distribution, pipe sizing and rack-level diversity. That is why the number on the nameplate is not the number you can sell.

**重点表达：**
- `On paper, yes.` — 纸面上是这样——先肯定再转折
- `Coincident load becomes connected load.` — 同时系数拉满时，装机容量就等于实际需求
- `Your five hundred quietly becomes about three hundred.` — 500kW 余量悄悄变成了 300kW
- `The row is not 100% liquid even when every rack says it is.` — 即使每面机柜都说是液冷，整排也没做到百分之百
- `Count another fifteen percent reaching the aisle.` — 还要再算百分之十五进风的热量
- `Bring twelve frames in and light eight.` — 拉进来十二个机架，只点亮八个
- `A rack you install but cannot energise is stranded capacity.` — 装了却送不上电的机柜就是搁浅容量
- `It sits there behind blanking panels earning nothing.` — 它隔着盲板杵在那儿，一分钱不挣
- `Plant-level refrigeration capacity is comfortable.` — 冷源侧的总制冷容量还很宽裕

cards.title: 日常工作 · 早班巡检发现 CDU 二次侧膨胀罐液位持续下降
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：早班接班抄表，你发现 3 号 CDU 二次侧膨胀罐液位三天里掉了 5%，补液泵启停次数明显变多，但机房地面和漏液检测绳都没有报警。你要判断：这是管路里残余气体还在慢慢排完的正常现象，还是有一处极其缓慢的微渗。

**对话：**
- Dave: Morning. Three CDUs running, no alarms overnight. The only thing I would flag is the expansion tank on unit three.
- 小白: How much has it moved?
- Dave: Down about five percent over three days, and the make-up pump is cycling maybe four times a shift. Nothing on the leak detection rope, nothing on the floor.
- 小白: Let us not call it a leak yet. We refilled that loop nine days ago, and a secondary side this size can hold air for a week or more. Trapped gas works its way to the high points, the level drops, and it looks exactly like a slow loss. What I want is the trend, not the snapshot.
- Dave: So what do you want to log?
- 小白: Level, make-up count, and secondary supply pressure, same time every shift, for three days. If it is residual air, the loss rate flattens and then stops. If it is a weep somewhere, the rate holds steady or gets worse, and pressure will start to sag between make-up cycles.
- Dave: And if it is a weep?
- 小白: Then we find it before it announces itself. A seep at a fitting under insulation stays invisible for months, and the first sign is usually corrosion on a rack base or a CDU that trips on low level during a weekend. I would rather spend an afternoon with a torch and a mirror.
- Dave: Fair. I will leave the numbers on the board.
- 小白: Log it as an observation for now, not a defect. If the trend does not flatten by Thursday I will raise a corrective work order and get the vendor out with the loop under pressure.

- `Let us not call it a leak yet.` — 先别急着定性为泄漏——巡检判断的开场
- `A secondary side this size can hold air for a week or more.` — 这么大的二次侧系统，气体可以滞留一周以上

cards.title: 故障排查 · 同排单机柜 CPU 温度高出 12℃：流量正常，问题在接触面
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：机房 B 排 7 号机柜的 CPU 温度比同排其他机柜高 12℃，GPU 已经开始降频，训练任务时延明显拉长。但 CDU 显示该支路流量、供液温度都正常，泵组 failover 测试上周也通过了。你要在不宕机的前提下，把问题定位到冷板与芯片之间的那层接触界面。

**对话：**
- Sarah: Rack B7 is running twelve degrees hotter than its neighbours. Same CDU, same loop, same setpoint. The GPUs have started throttling and job latency is up about thirty percent.
- 小白: Is the branch flow holding?
- Sarah: Yes. Flow is on setpoint, supply temperature is on setpoint, and the pump failover test passed last week. That is why it is on your desk and not the network team's.
- 小白: Then we are not short of cold, we are short of contact. The loop is doing its job and the heat is still sitting on the die. If flow and supply are both correct and the chip is hot, the resistance is between the die and the coolant, and that means the cold plate mount or the interface layer.
- Sarah: You think it is the thermal paste?
- 小白: I think it is the bond line, which is not the same thing. Too much material, uneven torque, or a plate that is sitting slightly proud on one corner all leave a gap that no amount of extra flow will close. And it will not show up as an alarm, because every sensor upstream of the die is reading happy.
- Sarah: So how do we prove it without taking the rack down?
- 小白: Compare like with like. Pull the inlet and outlet temperatures on B7 and on B6 next to it, at the same load, and work out the rise across each cold plate. If B7 is moving less heat with the same flow, its rise is lower and the die is hotter. That gap is the bond line talking.
- Sarah: And then?
- 小白: Then it is a scheduled intervention, not an emergency. We drain that branch, pull the plate, check the torque sequence against the manual, and re-do the interface. I would rather book it in a maintenance window than let a throttled GPU turn into a killed job in the middle of a training run.
- Sarah: How long can it run like this?
- 小白: It is degraded, not dangerous. Uptime is not at risk yet, but we are spending capacity we already paid for: the plant has the cooling, the CDU has the flow, and we are still losing compute to a two-millimetre gap. Book it this week.

**重点表达：**
- `Rack B7 is running twelve degrees hotter than its neighbours.` — B7 机柜比同排高 12 度——用对比句描述异常
- `The branch flow is holding.` — 支路流量保持稳定
- `We are not short of cold, we are short of contact.` — 我们不缺冷量，缺的是接触
- `The heat is still sitting on the die.` — 热量还压在芯片上没能带走
- `The resistance is between the die and the coolant.` — 热阻出现在芯片到冷却液之间
- `It is the bond line, which is not the same thing.` — 问题是界面层厚度，这跟导热硅脂不是一回事
- `A plate sitting slightly proud on one corner.` — 冷板某一角略微翘起没压平
- `No amount of extra flow will close that gap.` — 再加多少流量也补不上这个间隙
- `Work out the rise across each cold plate.` — 算出每块冷板的温升
- `It is a scheduled intervention, not an emergency.` — 这是计划性检修，不是紧急抢修
- `It is degraded, not dangerous.` — 属于性能劣化，还没到危险程度
- `We are losing compute to a two-millimetre gap.` — 我们正为两毫米的间隙丢算力

cards.title: 供应商对接 · UQD 快接头采购：样品、插拔寿命、压降与阶梯价
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：二期液冷模组要补一批 UQD 快接头（drip-less quick-disconnect），用于冷板支路与 manifold 的连接。你手上只有单价和交期，还缺三样东西：样品实测的压降、断路插拔寿命与质保口径、以及批量阶梯价和质保起算点。你要在一通电话里把这些谈清楚。

**对话：**
- Kevin: Thanks for coming back to me. I can hold the quoted price for thirty days and standard lead time is eight weeks.
- 小白: Eight weeks is the part I am stuck on. Before I take a price to my manager, I need three things in writing: a sample set I can test, the rated mating cycles, and the pressure drop at our design flow.
- Kevin: Mating cycles are five hundred, and I can send samples this week. Pressure drop is in the datasheet, figure three.
- 小白: Figure three is at a flow rate that is not mine. I want the curve at our design flow, which is roughly forty percent lower, and I want it measured with our fluid, not water. Glycol at twenty-five percent moves very differently through a restriction, and a number taken with water in a lab will not survive my first winter.
- Kevin: Understood, I will get the curve redrawn. What about the warranty?
- 小白: That is the part that decides the order. Warranty starts from site acceptance, not from shipment, and it has to cover loss of coolant from a failed seal, not just the two dollars of machined brass. If a coupler weeps and it takes out a rack, the part is the cheapest thing in the room.
- Kevin: I will need to confirm that with our legal team. Anything else?
- 小白: Price breaks. Give me three tiers, at twenty-five, fifty and one hundred units, and hold the top tier for the full project. And I want the samples on the same part number and the same production line as the bulk order. A golden sample that came off a different tool tells me nothing.
- Kevin: That is reasonable. I will send the revised quotation by Friday.
- 小白: Send it with the test curve and the warranty wording, and I will sign it next week. Without those two attachments it is just a price list, and I cannot take a price list to a change board.

- `I can hold the quoted price for thirty days.` — 报价可保留 30 天
- `Standard lead time is eight weeks.` — 标准交期 8 周
- `I need three things in writing.` — 我需要三样东西落实在书面
- `Rated mating cycles are five hundred.` — 额定插拔寿命 500 次
- `Figure three is at a flow rate that is not mine.` — 图表三用的是跟我不同的流量工况
- `Measured with our fluid, not water.` — 要用我们的介质实测，而不是水
- `A number taken with water in a lab will not survive my first winter.` — 实验室用水测出的数字撑不过我的第一个冬天
- `Warranty starts from site acceptance, not from shipment.` — 质保从现场验收起算，不是发货
- `It has to cover loss of coolant from a failed seal.` — 质保要覆盖密封失效导致的冷却液损失
- `The part is the cheapest thing in the room.` — 零件是整个房间里最便宜的东西——谈责任的常用句

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 冷冻水一次侧变流量改造的变更评审
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：一次泵目前是定流量运行，多余的水走旁通管白流。改造方案是改成一次侧变流量（variable primary flow），让泵跟随实际负荷，一年大约能省 11 万度电、约 0.1 个 PUE。但冷机蒸发器有最小流量限制，旁通阀也要从泄压通路改成真正的控制元件。变更评审会上，你要说清收益、风险与中止判据。

**对话：**
- Elena: The variable primary flow retrofit is on the change board tomorrow. Give me the one-minute version. What are we buying?
- 小白: We are buying pump horsepower, and only that. Today the primary loop runs constant flow with a bypass that dumps the surplus straight back to the return. Variable primary lets the pumps follow the actual load, so at forty percent we stop pushing water through a bypass for no reason. On our load profile that is roughly a hundred and ten thousand kilowatt-hours a year, about a tenth of a PUE point.
- Elena: And what can go wrong?
- 小白: Two things, both on the chiller side. Every evaporator has a minimum flow. Starve it and you trip on low refrigerant temperature, or you start tube fouling that nobody sees for a year. Second, the bypass valve changes character: it stops being a relief path and becomes a control device. Its deadband and its failure position have to be written into the sequence, not left to the default.
- Elena: Failure position? That sounds like a detail.
- 小白: It decides which way the project fails. If the valve fails open we are back to constant flow and we lose the savings, which is embarrassing but safe. If it fails closed we are one bad differential pressure sensor away from a low-flow trip on a plant that is carrying the whole hall. I want it to fail open, and I want that written into the MOP, not the vendor's generic sequence.
- Elena: Give me an abort criterion.
- 小白: Any chiller that trips on low evaporator flow, or supply temperature that moves more than one degree in five minutes after a stage change. Either one reverts us to constant flow and stops the test. And I want it done one plant at a time with the other plant carrying the load, so we never test two unknowns at once.
- Elena: How long before you call it a success?
- 小白: Two weeks of trending at the new setpoints, and I want a hot afternoon in that window. A saving that only shows up on a mild morning is not a saving, it is a measurement artefact.

**重点表达：**
- `We are buying pump horsepower, and only that.` — 我们买到的只有泵功率这一项——开场就把收益边界说清
- `Variable primary lets the pumps follow the actual load.` — 一次侧变流量让泵跟随实际负荷
- `The bypass dumps the surplus straight back to the return.` — 旁通把多余流量直接放回回水
- `Every evaporator has a minimum flow.` — 每台蒸发器都有最小流量限制
- `It stops being a relief path and becomes a control device.` — 它从泄压通路变成了控制元件
- `Its deadband and its failure position have to be written into the sequence.` — 死区与故障位必须写进控制时序
- `We are one bad sensor away from a low-flow trip.` — 离低流量跳闸只差一个坏传感器
- `I want it to fail open, and I want that written into the MOP.` — 我要它故障开，而且写进 MOP
- `Any chiller that trips on low evaporator flow.` — 任一冷机因蒸发器低流量跳闸——中止判据
- `One plant at a time, with the other plant carrying the load.` — 一次只改一套，另一套承担负荷
- `We never test two unknowns at once.` — 绝不同时验证两个未知量
- `A saving that only shows up on a mild morning is a measurement artefact.` — 只在温和早晨出现的节能只是测量假象

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 液冷模组 CDU 供电与控制拓扑的共因故障评审
cards.subtitle: 精通 Proficient
cards.content:
**情境**：二期液冷模组上了 6 台 CDU，图纸上每台都是 A/B 双路供电，看起来满足可同时维护性。但你核对配电柜清单后发现：其中 4 台的 A、B 两路其实源自同一面子柜、共用一只母联开关；而且每台 CDU 的 24V 控制电源取自本柜。这意味着丢一路电时，负责切换的控制器也一起失电——冗余形同虚设。

**对话：**
- Marcus: Six CDUs on the new module, A and B feeders to each one. On paper you have concurrent maintainability.
- 小白: On paper. I pulled the panel schedules and on four of the six, A and B both originate from the same sub-board, downstream of one tie breaker. Kill that breaker for maintenance and I lose both feeds on four CDUs at once. That is not redundancy, that is a single point of failure wearing a label.
- Marcus: That is a construction issue. What is yours?
- 小白: The control power, and it is worse. Each CDU takes its twenty-four volt control supply from its own panel, so a feeder failure also takes out the controller that would have ordered the transfer. The standby pump never starts because the brain that tells it to start is sitting on the feed that just died. Common-cause failure, and it hides inside a cabinet, so no walkthrough is ever going to catch it.
- Marcus: That is fair. How do you want it fixed?
- 小白: Two changes. Control power from a dedicated UPS-fed source that is independent of the power feeds, so the controller survives the loss it is supposed to react to. And a physical split: CDUs one, three and five on the A board, two, four and six on the B board. Then a single loss costs me at most half the module, and the surviving units still have the hydraulic headroom to carry it.
- Marcus: Headroom you have actually measured, or headroom you assume?
- 小白: Measured, which is the next item. I want a live test: drop a feeder under load, not on a cold Sunday morning, and record the failover latency and the rack inlet temperature through the transfer. A failover test at ten percent load tells you the contactor pulls in. It tells you nothing about whether the loop holds pressure while the standby pump comes up to speed.
- Marcus: You want to drop a feeder during production hours.
- 小白: Yes, and that is the entire point. If we only ever test it cold, the first real test is the one a customer pays for, and it will happen during a training run at full density when there is no margin anywhere in the building. I would rather burn an afternoon now with a rollback ready than find out at two in the morning.
- Marcus: And if the test goes badly?
- 小白: Then the abort criterion is temperature, not the clock. If rack inlet crosses thirty-two degrees for more than ninety seconds, we restore the feed and reopen the finding. Uptime is not a document review; it is what happens when the plant is hot and nobody is expecting it.

**重点表达：**
- `On paper you have concurrent maintainability.` — 纸面上你具备可同时维护性——先肯定，再翻案
- `A and B both originate from the same sub-board, downstream of one tie breaker.` — A、B 两路都源自同一面子柜，在同一只母联开关下游
- `That is not redundancy, that is a single point of failure wearing a label.` — 那不是冗余，是挂着标签的单点故障
- `The brain that tells it to start is sitting on the feed that just died.` — 下达启动指令的控制器就在刚失电的那条路上
- `Common-cause failure, and it hides inside a cabinet.` — 共因故障，而且藏在柜子里
- `So the controller survives the loss it is supposed to react to.` — 让控制器能在它本该响应的失电中存活
- `A single loss costs me at most half the module.` — 一次失电最多损失半个模组
- `The surviving units still have the hydraulic headroom to carry it.` — 存活机组仍要有水力余量顶住
- `Drop a feeder under load, not on a cold Sunday morning.` — 带载掉电测试，别挑冷清的周日早上
- `A failover test at ten percent load tells you the contactor pulls in.` — 10% 负载的切换测试只证明接触器吸合
- `The first real test is the one a customer pays for.` — 第一次真正的检验是客户买单的那次
- `The abort criterion is temperature, not the clock.` — 中止判据是温度，不是时间
- `Uptime is not a document review.` — 可用时间不是文件审出来的

cards.title: 容量规划 · 单机柜 30kW 提到 60kW：manifold 与 CDU 的余量与调节比
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：客户明年要上新一代 GPU，单机柜密度从 30kW 提到 60kW。现有 CDU 铭牌换热量 350kW，二次泵调节比约 4:1，manifold 按 30kW、15℃ 温升选型。要判断三件事：名义换热量在高温季还剩多少、管道够不够、以及客户上架很慢时低负荷端会不会失稳。

**对话：**
- Priya: The customer wants sixty-kilowatt racks next year. The CDU nameplate says three hundred and fifty kilowatts. Is that twelve racks or six?
- 小白: Neither, not until we decide what the number means. That duty is quoted at a five degree approach on the primary side. If the facility water runs warmer in July, the duty drops before you have moved a single kilowatt of IT load. The honest answer is eight racks per CDU in July and ten in January, and I would rather sell it as eight.
- Priya: Eight it is. What about the piping?
- 小白: The manifold is the part you cannot fix later, so that is where I want the money. It was sized for thirty kilowatt racks at a fifteen degree rise. The same pipe carries sixty kilowatts only if we let the return run hotter or we push more flow, and more flow means higher velocity, higher pressure drop, and erosion at elbows nobody budgeted to replace.
- Priya: So oversize the pipe.
- 小白: Oversize the distribution, right-size the CDUs in stages. Pipe is cheap in year one and impossible in year three. Capacity in the plant is the opposite: you can always add a CDU, and adding one later costs you a weekend instead of a shutdown and a weld permit.
- Priya: What if they only fill half the racks at first? New GPU clusters roll out slowly.
- 小白: That is the turndown question, and it is where these projects actually break. Our pumps are good for about four to one. Below that the control valve hunts and the differential pressure sensor loses resolution, so the loop starts chasing itself. If we buy one large CDU for the whole module and they populate it over eighteen months, we spend that whole time fighting instability instead of selling capacity.
- Priya: So two smaller units.
- 小白: Two smaller units, second one landed on a spare breaker and a capped manifold branch. It costs a little more up front and behaves far better at the low end. Capacity you can add in a weekend is capacity you can sell. Capacity that needs an outage and a hot-work permit is stranded capacity, and it will sit there empty for years, because nobody wants to be the person who books the shutdown.

**重点表达：**
- `Neither, not until we decide what the number means.` — 两个都不是——先说清这个数字指什么
- `The duty is quoted at a five degree approach.` — 换热量是在 5 度趋近温度下给出的——口径要点
- `The duty drops before you have moved a single kilowatt of IT load.` — IT 负荷一瓦没加，换热量先掉了
- `Eight racks per CDU in July and ten in January.` — 7 月每台 CDU 带 8 柜，1 月带 10 柜——随季节给数
- `The manifold is the part you cannot fix later.` — manifold 是后面补不回来的部分
- `More flow means higher velocity, higher pressure drop, and erosion at the elbows.` — 流量加大意味着流速、压降上升和弯头冲蚀
- `Oversize the distribution, right-size the CDUs in stages.` — 管路放大，CDU 分期按需配置
- `Pipe is cheap in year one and impossible in year three.` — 管路第一年便宜，第三年改不动
- `That is the turndown question, and it is where these projects break.` — 这是调节比问题，也是项目翻车的地方
- `The pumps are good for about four to one.` — 泵调节比约 4:1
- `Below that the control valve hunts and the loop chases itself.` — 低于该比值调节阀震荡，环路自己追自己
- `They populate it over eighteen months.` — 他们用 18 个月慢慢上架
- `Capacity you can add in a weekend is capacity you can sell.` — 一个周末能加上的容量才是能卖的容量
- `Stranded capacity sits empty because nobody wants to book the shutdown.` — 搁浅容量一直空着，因为没人愿意排停机窗口

cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：本周有 6 台 30kW 冷板机柜接入 CDU-2。投运前要走一遍点检：环路冲洗与充注水质是否达标、快速接头两端型号是否一致并插合到位、manifold 高点排气是否排净、漏液检测绳每个分区是否真的报警并报到 DCIM 的正确点位。最后一步最关键——按统一方法录一套基线（支路流量、冷板压差、供回液温度），否则后面没法判断漂移。

**对话：**
- Owen: Six new cold-plate racks land on CDU-2 this week. Before you energise, walk me through the checklist.
- 小白: It starts before any fluid moves. I confirm the loop is flushed and the fill water meets the spec on the COA, and I check every quick-disconnect: same part number on both halves, seated, locked, dust caps back on the spare ports. A mismatched half is how you get a weep at forty litres an hour.
- Owen: And purging?
- 小白: I purge at the rack manifold until I stop getting air at the high points, then I do it again after the first heat cycle, because dissolved air comes out of solution once the loop warms up. Only then do I record the baseline: flow per branch, differential pressure across the cold plate, supply and return temperature, all on a logged trend, not a handwritten sheet.
- Owen: Why the trend? A numbers sheet is easier to hand over.
- 小白: Because you cannot detect drift later without a baseline taken the same way. Six months from now, if branch flow is down twelve percent, that number only means something if today it was recorded at the same valve positions and the same pump speed.
- Owen: Leak detection?
- 小白: Every rope zone gets walked with a wet cloth before handover, so we know the alarm actually annunciates to DCIM and drops a pin on the right zone. Then I set thresholds off the baseline: a fifteen percent drop in branch flow or a twenty percent rise in differential pressure is a work order, not a phone call at two in the morning.

**重点表达：**
- `It starts before any fluid moves.` — 工作从介质流动之前就开始了——点检的起点在充注之前
- `The fill water meets the spec on the COA.` — 充注水质符合分析报告上的规格——COA = certificate of analysis
- `Same part number on both halves, seated and locked.` — 接头两端型号一致、插合并锁死——冷板快接的点检要点
- `A mismatched half is how you get a weep at forty litres an hour.` — 型号不匹配就是每小时 40 升微渗的来源——weep 微渗，比 leak 更准
- `I purge at the rack manifold until I stop getting air at the high points.` — 在机柜 manifold 排气，直到高点不再出气
- `Dissolved air comes out of solution once the loop warms up.` — 环路升温后溶解空气会析出——所以要二次排气
- `You cannot detect drift later without a baseline taken the same way.` — 没有用同一方法取的基线，后面判断不了漂移
- `Every rope zone gets walked with a wet cloth before handover.` — 交付前每个检测绳分区都用湿布实测一遍
- `That is a work order, not a phone call at two in the morning.` — 那是走工单，不是凌晨两点打电话——告警分级的直白说法

cards.title: 故障排查 · 机柜内冷板被接成串联：末端温升 8℃ 与整排流量被抢的 RCA
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
**情境**：4 排两台新上的 GPU 机柜报后段板卡结温高，CDU 供液温度却稳稳卡在 30℃ 设定值上。查压差发现机柜压降 112kPa，设计值只有 45kPa；同排邻柜流量同时掉了约 10%，切备泵后更明显。RCA 最终落到接管拓扑——安装方把机柜内 4 块冷板接成了串联。

**对话：**
- Daniel: Two racks on row four are reporting high die temperature on the rear boards. The CDU says supply is at thirty degrees, exactly on setpoint.
- 小白: Supply temperature is the right first check, but it tells us what we are delivering, not what the rack is getting. What is the differential pressure across the rack?
- Daniel: One hundred and twelve kilopascals. The design says forty-five.
- 小白: That is the real signal. The rack is not short of cold, it is short of flow. The pump is at a hundred percent and the loops next to it dropped about ten percent at the same time, so the pump is not weak, it is being pulled to the end of its curve by one high-resistance branch. One rack hogging the flow starves its neighbours.
- Daniel: So what changed? These racks are new.
- 小白: They are, and that is the point. The installer piped the four cold plates in series instead of parallel. Every plate sees the same flow but each one adds its pressure drop, and the last plate gets water that has already picked up heat from three others. That is your eight degree spread from front to rear.
- Daniel: Why did it get worse when the CDU failed over to the standby pump?
- 小白: Because we were already sitting near the end of the pump curve. Failover restored stable pressure in about forty seconds, and for those forty seconds the starved racks had no margin at all. The redundancy was fine; the headroom was gone. Failover protects you against losing a pump, not against running out of hydraulic margin.
- Daniel: So this is not a CDU problem.
- 小白: No. The RCA lands on the piping topology, not on the CDU. Fix is re-piping those two racks in parallel, then re-record the baseline with the same method so the drift detection still means something. And I want the as-built drawings corrected before the next rack lands, otherwise we are commissioning the same mistake one row at a time.

**重点表达：**
- `It tells us what we are delivering, not what the rack is getting.` — 它只说明我们送出去了什么，不说明机柜实际拿到了什么
- `The rack is not short of cold, it is short of flow.` — 机柜缺的不是冷量，是流量——液冷排查的分水岭判断
- `The pump is not weak, it is being pulled to the end of its curve.` — 泵没坏，是被高阻支路拉到了曲线末端
- `One rack hogging the flow starves its neighbours.` — 一个机柜抢流量，同排邻柜就挨饿——hog / starve 很地道
- `They piped the cold plates in series instead of parallel.` — 他们把冷板接成了串联而不是并联
- `The last plate gets water that has already picked up heat from three others.` — 末端冷板拿到的是已被前三块加热过的水
- `Failover restored stable pressure in about forty seconds.` — 切换后约 40 秒才恢复压力稳定——latency 的另一种说法
- `The redundancy was fine; the headroom was gone.` — 冗余没坏，是余量没了——高级判断句
- `Failover protects you against losing a pump, not against running out of hydraulic margin.` — 冗余切换能防丢泵，防不了水力余量耗尽
- `The RCA lands on the piping topology, not on the CDU.` — 根因落在接管拓扑，不在 CDU
- `I want the as-built drawings corrected before the next rack lands.` — 下一台机柜进场前必须更正竣工图

cards.title: 供应商对接 · 液冷年度维保合同谈判：响应时效、遥测边界、备件寄售与罚则
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：液冷区刚过质保期，谈年度维保。四个争点：到场时效（次工作日 vs 4 小时 7×24）、远程遥测接入边界（只读单向、不开放控制通道、数据归属）、关键备件的寄售模式与结算、罚则上限与免责。风冷侧（CRAH、冷机）冗余充分，不该和水侧同价。

**对话：**
- Nadia: Our standard service agreement is next-business-day response, eight to five, at a fixed annual fee.
- 小白: Next business day is not a fit for a hall with a liquid loop. Two hours above the ASHRAE envelope across two thousand CPUs is a customer-visible event, and I cannot wait until Thursday for it. I need four-hour on-site response, twenty-four seven, on the CDU and the manifolds.
- Nadia: Four-hour response roughly doubles the fee.
- 小白: Then split it. Four-hour on the CDU and the pump skid, next-day on the air side. The CRAH units and the chillers already carry N+1, and I can hold them on a spare for a day. Price the urgent path where the redundancy is thin, not the whole plant.
- Nadia: We would also want remote telemetry from the CDU controllers, so we can diagnose before we travel.
- 小白: Read-only, one-way, and it stops at temperature, flow, pressure and alarm state. No control path, and no setpoint writes over the network. The data stays ours; you get it for diagnosis, not for a benchmark database. Put that in the agreement in writing, because verbal assurances do not survive a staff change.
- Nadia: And spares?
- 小白: Pump seals, a spare VFD, quick-disconnect sets and two differential pressure sensors stay on the shelf here, on consignment: we pay when we issue, you own the stock until then. Shelf life and calibration dates are yours to manage. If I reach for a seal and find it a year out of date, that is a service failure, not a purchasing problem.
- Nadia: Last point. Our liability clause caps everything at the annual fee.
- 小白: On missed response time, capped liquidated damages, fine, and waived if we block your site access, that is fair to both of us. What I will not accept is a cap that also covers a leak that damages IT equipment. Uptime is the product we sell; a clause that makes a coolant leak cheaper for you than preventing it is a clause that guarantees I will have one.

**重点表达：**
- `Next business day is not a fit for a hall with a liquid loop.` — 次工作日响应对液冷厅不合适——谈判开场定调
- `Two hours above the ASHRAE envelope is a customer-visible event.` — 超出 ASHRAE 包络两小时就是客户看得见的事件——把技术参数翻译成业务影响
- `Price the urgent path where the redundancy is thin, not the whole plant.` — 加急服务定价放在冗余薄弱的环节，而不是全厂——拆分报价的砍价技巧
- `The CRAH units and the chillers already carry N+1.` — CRAH 和冷机已经有 N+1 冗余——用冗余度支撑分级定价
- `Read-only, one-way, no control path.` — 只读、单向、不开放控制通道——遥测接入的三条底线
- `No setpoint writes over the network.` — 不允许通过网络写设定值
- `Verbal assurances do not survive a staff change.` — 口头承诺经不起人员变动——坚持写进合同的理由
- `On consignment: we pay when we issue, you own the stock until then.` — 寄售模式：领用才付款，库存归你方
- `If I reach for a seal and find it out of date, that is a service failure.` — 领用发现备件过期，属于服务失效，不是采购问题
- `Capped liquidated damages, waived if we block your site access.` — 设上限的违约金，若我方阻拦进场则免责——双向公平的表述
- `Uptime is the product we sell.` — 我们卖的产品就是可用时间——谈判收尾的重量级一句

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 供液温度设定值上调 5℃ 的变更评审：换免费制冷小时，还是换告警
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：入秋后室外湿球温度下来了，小白提了一份变更：把液冷二次侧供液温度设定值从 30℃ 上调到 35℃，换取更多免费制冷小时数、把冷机能耗压下来。评审要过三关——IT 侧进液温度仍在 ASHRAE A1 允许范围内并留出余量、供液温度必须高于机房露点防结露、告警阈值必须跟着设定值一起改，否则等于自己造告警。

**对话：**
- Priya: You put in a change request to raise the secondary supply setpoint from thirty to thirty-five degrees. Walk me through it.
- 小白: It is an efficiency change, not a capacity change. At thirty we are running the chillers to make water colder than the weather will give us for free. At thirty-five we buy roughly six hundred more free-cooling hours a year and take about three to four hundredths off PUE.
- Priya: Thirty-five sits near the top of the A1 allowable envelope. What is your margin?
- 小白: Two guards. The IT inlet stays inside A1 with about four degrees of headroom, and I have that in writing from the server team, not a verbal yes. Second, we hold supply above the room dew point by a fixed margin; if the dew point climbs, the setpoint follows it up rather than the other way round.
- Priya: And the alarms? That is where these changes usually go wrong.
- 小白: Exactly. If I move the setpoint and leave the high-liquid-temperature threshold at thirty-two, I am just manufacturing alarms. I move the threshold with the setpoint and re-baseline the trend so the drift detection still means something. Rollback is one line: two racks above A1 at once, or the CDU loses failover for any reason, and we are back to thirty. It protects uptime because the rollback takes minutes, not hours.

**重点表达：**
- `It is an efficiency change, not a capacity change.` — 这是能效变更，不是容量变更——评审开场先定性，避免被当成扩容来审
- `We are running the chillers to make water colder than the weather will give us for free.` — 我们在开冷机，把水制冷到比天气免费给的水还冷——一句话点出免费制冷被浪费
- `We buy roughly six hundred more free-cooling hours a year.` — 每年多换来约 600 小时免费制冷——buy hours 是能效方案里的地道说法
- `The IT inlet stays inside A1 with about four degrees of headroom.` — IT 进液仍在 A1 允许范围内，还有约 4 度余量——headroom 余量，是安全边界的高频词
- `We hold supply above the room dew point by a fixed margin.` — 供液温度要高于机房露点并保留固定余量——防结露的技术底线
- `If I move the setpoint and leave the threshold behind, I am just manufacturing alarms.` — 设定值改了而阈值不动，等于自己制造告警——manufacture alarms 非常地道
- `I re-baseline the trend so the drift detection still means something.` — 我重设趋势基线，让漂移检测仍然有意义——变更后必做的一件事
- `The rollback takes minutes, not hours.` — 回滚以分钟计，不是小时——变更评审里最有说服力的一句

cards.title: 跨团队协作 · 漏液检测联动处置矩阵：断不断电，归谁说了算
cards.subtitle: 高级 Advanced
cards.content:
**情境**：二期液冷区送电前，小白和电气团队定漏液联动的处置矩阵。电气侧本能反应是「水靠近带电设备就断电」，但二次侧是低电导率的缓蚀乙二醇溶液，先断电会让 CDU 泵停转、冷板不再带走热量，服务器反而先过热。双方按三级分级划界：单点渗漏不动电不停泵；manifold 级泄漏双条件确认才停泵隔离、IT 有序下电；介质进入母线槽或配电柜区域才归电气立即跳闸。还要加双区确认和 30 秒防抖，避免冷凝水导致误下电。

**对话：**
- Marcus: If the leak rope trips in the liquid-cooled zone, my guys kill the feeder. That is the standing rule for water near live gear.
- 小白: I understand the instinct, but with this loop, killing power first makes the event bigger, not smaller. The fluid is inhibited glycol at low conductivity. If you de-energise, the CDU pumps stop, the cold plates stop moving heat, and the servers overheat before anyone can isolate a branch.
- Marcus: So what do you want instead?
- 小白: A graded response, written down before we energise phase two. Grade one is one rope zone and a small flow deviation on one branch: no power action, no pump stop. I close the branch isolation valve and raise a work order. Grade two is a manifold-level leak confirmed two ways, rope plus flow deviation plus floor drain level: pumps stop, CDU isolated, and IT runs an orderly shutdown on their own timeline.
- Marcus: And grade three?
- 小白: Grade three is fluid reaching the busway or a distribution board. That one is yours, and I want your team to trip without calling me first. Anything above the floor is mine; anything entering live electrical space is yours. The MOP says so in one line, so nobody is negotiating during an event.
- Marcus: What about false trips? Condensation on the rope gave us two last month.
- 小白: Two-zone confirmation and a thirty-second debounce before anything escalates. A wet rope from condensation is a maintenance ticket, not an incident. I would rather explain one missed escalation than explain to a customer why we dropped their rack and burned four hours of uptime over a puddle of condensate.

**重点表达：**
- `Killing power first makes the event bigger, not smaller.` — 先断电只会把事件扩大，而不是缩小——跨团队分歧的立论句
- `The fluid is inhibited glycol at low conductivity.` — 介质是低电导率的缓蚀乙二醇溶液——用介质特性说明漏电风险可控
- `The pumps stop and the cold plates stop moving heat.` — 泵一停，冷板就不再带走热量——说明断电的次生后果

cards.title: 容量规划 · 1MW 液冷二期：CDU 是 N+1 还是 2N，第四台现在买还是等
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：规划二期 40 台 25kW 冷板机柜，合计 1MW。讨论四个问题：需要几台 CDU、冗余做 N+1 还是 2N、四台是一次装齐还是分期、manifold 分支接口留多少余量。还要兼顾大厅里剩下的风冷机柜——它们仍走 CRAH 冷热通道布局，别让它们成为新的瓶颈。

**对话：**
- Elena: Forty racks at twenty-five kilowatts, a megawatt, landing in Q2. How many CDUs is that?
- 小白: Four three-hundred-kilowatt units gives you three-plus-one, so a single CDU failure still leaves enough capacity to carry the full load. That is N+1 at CDU level, and it is what I would build.
- Elena: Do we need 2N?
- 小白: Not for this hall. 2N doubles your CDU count and your floor space for a failure mode that already has a manual workaround — the branch isolation valves let us move a rack onto the neighbouring CDU in under an hour. I would rather spend that money on spare quick-disconnects and a spare pump. But each CDU has to sit on a different primary loop, otherwise you have N+1 on paper and a shared single point of failure in the piping.
- Elena: Do we buy all four now?
- 小白: Buy the space and the piping for four, install three. The fourth carries a four-month lead time, so if we wait until the hall is eighty percent full we run hot with no failover for a quarter. But I would not energise it until the load arrives — an idle CDU is stranded capacity and it still shows up in PUE.
- Elena: And the air-cooled racks we are leaving in the hall?
- 小白: They stay on CRAH units in a contained hot-cold aisle. Keep those aisles sealed and the air-cooled side stops competing with the liquid loop for capacity; leave them open and the recirculation becomes the constraint long before the plant does.
- Elena: Ports on the manifold?
- 小白: Twenty percent spare ports on every manifold, capped and blanked. Every rack we add after this phase becomes a two-hour job instead of a shutdown. It is the cheapest capacity insurance in the whole build.

**重点表达：**
- `Four three-hundred-kilowatt units gives you three-plus-one.` — 四台 300kW 就是三用一备——容量换算的标准说法
- `A single CDU failure still leaves enough capacity to carry the full load.` — 单台 CDU 故障仍能带满载——N+1 的定义式表达
- `2N doubles your CDU count and your floor space for a failure mode that has a manual workaround.` — 2N 让设备数量和占地翻倍，换来的却是一个有人工兜底的故障模式
- `You have N+1 on paper and a shared single point of failure in the piping.` — 纸面上是 N+1，管路里却藏着共用单点故障——on paper 的高级用法
- `Buy the space and the piping for four, install three.` — 按四台预留空间和管路，先装三台——分期建设的经典表述
- `An idle CDU is stranded capacity and it still shows up in PUE.` — 闲置的 CDU 是搁浅容量，而且照样计入 PUE——stranded capacity 高频术语
- `They stay on CRAH units in a contained hot-cold aisle.` — 它们继续用 CRAH，走封闭冷热通道——风冷与液冷共存的交代
- `Leave the aisles open and the recirculation becomes the constraint long before the plant does.` — 通道不封闭，回流会先于冷源成为瓶颈——constraint 瓶颈判定
- `Twenty percent spare ports on every manifold, capped and blanked.` — 每个 manifold 留 20% 备用接口并封盖堵头
- `It is the cheapest capacity insurance in the whole build.` — 这是整个建设里最便宜的容量保险——一句收尾，很有说服力

cards.title: 日常工作 · CDU 例行巡检抄表：压差从 35 爬到 62，该开工单了
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：早班交接，小白带接班同事在液冷区做 CDU 例行巡检抄表。要按固定顺序核对六项：二次侧供液温度、回液温度、支路流量、过滤器压差、电导率、泄漏检测状态；一次侧只扫一眼，数字没动就不深究。抄到 3 号 CDU 时发现二次侧过滤器压差从 35kPa 爬到 62kPa，超过 50kPa 的清洗阈值，但流量仍然稳定，属于该整改还没出事的窗口期。

**对话：**
- Dave: Morning. What are we checking on the CDUs before I take the shift?
- 小白: Six things, and I read them in the same order every time so I never skip one. Secondary supply temperature, return temperature, branch flow, differential pressure across the strainer, conductivity, and the leak detection status. On the primary side I only glance unless the numbers move.
- Dave: Number three looks different from yesterday.
- 小白: Good catch. The strainer differential has crept from thirty-five to sixty-two kilopascals. Our cleaning threshold is fifty, so it is due. Flow is still holding, which means the loop is not starved yet, but I would rather clean it on my shift than hand it over.
- Dave: Does that mean a work order?
- 小白: Yes, a corrective one, not a breakdown. I will log it against CDU-3, tag the unit as under maintenance in the DCIM, and keep the standby pump in auto so we still have failover if the primary trips while the strainer is open.

**重点表达：**
- `I read them in the same order every time so I never skip one.` — 我每次都按同一顺序读表，绝不漏项——交班时最该说的一句，强调巡检的规范性
- `The strainer differential has crept from thirty-five to sixty-two kilopascals.` — 过滤器压差已经从 35 慢慢爬到 62 kPa——creep 表示缓慢爬升，比 rise 更贴合趋势劣化
- `Our cleaning threshold is fifty, so it is due.` — 我们的清洗阈值是 50，所以它到期了——due 表示「到期该做了」，比 needs cleaning 更地道
- `Flow is still holding, which means the loop is not starved yet.` — 流量还稳着，说明回路还没到缺流的程度——starve 缺流/供不上，是液冷与水系统高频词
- `I would rather clean it on my shift than hand it over.` — 我宁可在自己这个班清掉，也不把它交出去——would rather ... than ... 是交班责任心最自然的说法
- `I will log it as a corrective work order, not a breakdown.` — 我把它记为整改性工单，而不是故障停机——corrective work order 与 breakdown 的区分，直接影响 KPI 口径
- `Keep the standby pump in auto so we still have failover.` — 把备泵保持在自动位，这样还留有故障切换能力——failover 冷源/泵组切换，是运维核心术语

cards.title: 故障排查 · 液冷机柜进液温度偏高 9℃：不是堵了，是节流了
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：B 区第 7 排一台液冷机柜的进液温度比同排高 9℃，二次侧支路流量比同 manifold 其他机柜低约 18%。排查要先把层级分开：看总管流量与供液温度是否在设定值、上周的 CDU 泵切换测试是否过关，排除冷源侧；再下到支路看过滤器压差、平衡阀开度、快接头插接状态。最终落在上次换板卡后回液侧快接头未完全插合、O 圈压偏导致局部节流。

**对话：**
- Nadia: Row seven, rack B7-04. Liquid inlet is running nine degrees warmer than its neighbours. What is your read?
- 小白: Before I touch anything, I want to know whether this is a plant problem or a branch problem. A rack-level inlet that runs hot while the loop header is steady points downstream, not at the CDU.
- Nadia: Agreed. What did the CDU say?
- 小白: Header flow and supply temperature are both on setpoint, and the pump failover test we ran last week came back clean at under thirty seconds latency. So the plant is not starving that rack. On the branch itself, flow is down about eighteen percent against the other racks on the same manifold.
- Nadia: Eighteen percent is a lot. Strainer?
- 小白: That was my first thought, and it is not the strainer — the differential is flat. What we found is the quick-disconnect on the return leg is not fully seated since the card swap on Tuesday. The O-ring is pinched, so we are throttling the branch rather than clogging it. Same symptom, completely different fix.
- Nadia: So where does the RCA land?
- 小白: On the seating check, not on the hardware. The connector passed a visual inspection and failed a flow test, which tells me the visual step in our MOP is not good enough. I want a post-swap flow verification added before the rack is released back to production, and I will write it up as a corrective action rather than a part failure.
- Nadia: Do it, and bring the numbers to the review.

**重点表达：**
- `I want to know whether this is a plant problem or a branch problem.` — 我要先分清这是冷源侧问题还是支路问题——排查分层起手句，避免一上来就拆件
- `The pump failover test came back clean at under thirty seconds latency.` — 泵切换测试结果干净，延迟在 30 秒以内——failover latency 是切换能力的核心量化指标
- `The plant is not starving that rack.` — 冷源并没有让这个机柜缺流——starve 用在这里，一句话排除冷源侧嫌疑
- `Flow is down about eighteen percent against the other racks on the same manifold.` — 与同一 manifold 上其他机柜相比，流量低了约 18%——against 表示「与……对照」
- `It is not the strainer — the differential is flat.` — 不是过滤器，压差没有变化——flat 表示曲线不动，是排除法常用说法
- `The quick-disconnect is not fully seated.` — 快接头没有完全插合到位——seated 就位/坐实，是液冷快接口的标准说法
- `We are throttling the branch rather than clogging it.` — 我们是在节流这条支路，而不是堵住它——throttle vs clog 的对比，是本次 RCA 的结论核心
- `The RCA lands on the seating check, not on the hardware.` — 根因落在插接检查环节，而不是硬件本身——lands on 表示根因归结到某处

cards.title: 供应商对接 · CDU 年度备件包：交期、寄售与质保起算点
cards.subtitle: 基础 Basic
cards.content:
**情境**：小白与原厂确认 CDU 年度备件包，清单是快接头、Y 型过滤器滤芯、乙二醇和一块控制板。谈判要点四件事：控制板 8 周交期太长，要求合同写 4 周；常用件走寄售放现场，按领用结算；乙二醇每桶要随 COA 分析报告并标注保质期，因为库里放过一批十八个月后变浑浊；质保从现场验收起算而不是发货日起算，价格锁定十二个月。

**对话：**
- Ken: I have put the annual spares package together — quick-disconnects, strainer elements, glycol and one control board. Lead time on the board is eight weeks.
- 小白: Eight weeks is too long for a board that takes the CDU out of failover when it fails. Two things: I want the board on the shelf here, and I want the lead time in the contract at four, not eight.
- Ken: We can hold it on consignment, but you pay on issue and there is a minimum quantity.
- 小白: Consignment works for the disconnects and the strainer elements, because those are the parts I actually turn. Glycol I will buy outright, but I need a certificate of analysis with each drum and the shelf life stated on the label. I have had a batch go cloudy after eighteen months in our store.
- Ken: Understood. And the warranty?
- 小白: Warranty starts from site acceptance, not from your ship date. If a board sits in your warehouse for six weeks and then another two in mine, I do not want to find it dead on the day I install it with the clock already running. Twelve months from acceptance, price held for twelve, and I will sign it.

**重点表达：**
- `Lead time on the board is eight weeks.` — 这块控制板交期八周——lead time 交期，是采购对话的开场数字
- `I want the board on the shelf here.` — 我要这块板现场就有现货——on the shelf 字面「在货架上」，指现场备货
- `We can hold it on consignment, but you pay on issue.` — 我们可以做寄售，但按领用结算——consignment 寄售、pay on issue 领用时付款
- `Those are the parts I actually turn.` — 这些才是真正会周转的备件——turn 指库存周转，一句话划清该寄售哪些件
- `I need a certificate of analysis with each drum.` — 每桶都要随附分析报告 COA——液冷介质验收的硬要求
- `I have had a batch go cloudy after eighteen months.` — 我遇到过一批存放十八个月后变浑浊——用既往事故支撑验收条件，比空口要求更有力
- `Warranty starts from site acceptance, not from your ship date.` — 质保从现场验收起算，而不是从发货日——质保起算点谈判的标准句式
- `Price held for twelve months.` — 价格锁定十二个月——hold the price 表示锁价，年度框架协议常用

cards.title: 运维沟通 · 水蓄冷罐投运变更评审：省钱可以，但别把它当冗余
cards.subtitle: 进阶 Intermediate
cards.content:
**情境**：园区新建的三千立方米水蓄冷罐要正式投运，思路是谷电时段充冷、峰电时段放冷做削峰填谷。小白在变更评审会上要讲清三件事：它是电费套利资产而不是容量资产，绝不能被当成 N+1 冷源计入可用性；放冷末期斜温层到达出水口后供水温度会从 7℃ 爬到 11℃，CRAH 阀门开大而除湿余量被吃掉，这一条必须写成 MOP 里的硬限值；冷机重启时机要按斜温层位置触发而非按时钟，并写明中止判据。

**对话：**
- Rachel: Walk me through the change. We have run this plant for six years without a tank, so I want to understand exactly what we are putting in the middle of it.
- 小白: It is an energy arbitrage asset, not a capacity asset. We charge it overnight off-peak and discharge through the four-hour peak window, which takes about two point four megawatts off the chillers when the grid is dirtiest and most expensive. What it is not is a redundant source, and I do not want anyone counting it as N plus one. Our uptime commitment is backed by mechanical cooling, not by stored water.
- Rachel: What changes at the tail end of the discharge?
- 小白: Supply temperature creeps from seven to eleven degrees once the thermocline reaches the outlet. The CRAH valves open to compensate and we lose dehumidification margin on the two rows that already run tight. That is the part I want in the MOP as a hard limit, not as a note. And the PUE figure will flatter us during the discharge because the compressors are off — I want that documented as a measurement artefact, not claimed as an efficiency win.
- Rachel: And if a chiller does not come back when we need it?
- 小白: Then we are running on stored cooling with a shrinking buffer, which is the one condition I will not accept silently. I want the restart triggered on thermocline position rather than a clock, and an abort criterion written in: if any chiller fails to reach full load within ninety seconds of the restart command, we stop the discharge and go back to mechanical cooling. Storage buys us minutes. It does not buy us an hour.
- Rachel: Fine. Put the valve limits, the abort logic and the tail-end temperature in the MOP and I will sign it.

**重点表达：**
- `It is an energy arbitrage asset, not a capacity asset.` — 它是个电费套利资产，不是容量资产——一句话划清蓄冷罐的定位，是变更评审的定调句
- `I do not want anyone counting it as N plus one.` — 我不想有人把它当作 N+1 计入冗余——count something as 表示「把某物算作」，是容量口径争论里的高频说法
- `Supply temperature creeps from seven to eleven degrees once the thermocline reaches the outlet.` — 斜温层一到出水口，供水温度就从 7℃ 慢慢爬到 11℃——thermocline 斜温层、creep 缓慢爬升，都是水蓄冷的专有说法
- `That is the part I want in the MOP as a hard limit, not as a note.` — 这一段我要写进 MOP 里当硬限值，而不是当一条备注——hard limit vs note 的对比，体现文件严肃性
- `We are running on stored cooling with a shrinking buffer.` — 我们正靠蓄冷运行，而缓冲在一点点缩水——shrinking buffer 形象表达风险敞口在扩大
- `Storage buys us minutes. It does not buy us an hour.` — 蓄冷为我们买来的是几分钟，不是一个小时——并列否定句，谈应急能力边界时非常有说服力
